name: v51-arms
note: Arms A-E of the v5.1 plan. Every arm starts from the round-54 checkpoint with the same training budget (72 Lion steps, lr 1.5e-5, batch 4, top 24 blocks, bf16), the same evaluation (greedy, unchanged harness) and the same seeds; each arm changes only its data options. The held-out leakage fix applies to every arm (it is a correctness fix, not a variable under test). Decision metric: dev score without the items the checkpoint saw in equivalent form (dev_clean).
